title.narrative: Supporting Financing for Small Island Developing States (SIDS) (FINS) through the Integrated National Financing Framework (INFF)

description.narrative: The main objective of the pilot project is to strengthen capacity of targeted SIDS to mobilize resources, including climate finance, for achieving national sustainable development priorities and the SDGs. Support by UN DESA through this pilot project is complementary to UNDP country support, providing high calibre embedded experts who work in country, as well as tailored mentoring support and training at the region-al and global level. This in-depth support both addresses the special needs of SIDS and serves as a basis for refining and developing global analytical work. Outcomes of the pilot project would be levered to sup-port implementation of INFFs across a wide range of SIDS and broader group of developing countries.
